title: AI puts growing pressure on US open records systems
excerpt: The rise of artificial intelligence is creating new strains for public records offices across the United States.
body_html:
The integration and rise of artificial intelligence are creating significant challenges for public records systems across the United States.

In places like Panton, Vermont, local officials who manage multiple municipal duties—including budgets, elections, and zoning—are also responsible for fulfilling public records requests. As automated tools and modern digital workflows increase the volume and complexity of information inquiries, traditional administrative systems face mounting pressure to keep pace.

Public records offices, often operating with limited staff and resources, must now navigate the unique demands brought on by automated data generation and retrieval. The situation highlights the growing intersection between modern technology and local government operations, as civic workers manage the impacts of these changes during routine office hours.
